### Covenant Renewal on Ebal
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://www.ligonier.org/learn/devotionals/covenant-renewal-on-ebal
Passage: Joshua 8:30-35
Points:
- Following victories at Jericho and Ai, Israel paused military campaigns to worship God between Mount Ebal and Mount Gerizim.
- Building the altar and reading the Law obeyed Moses' commands at the exact land originally promised to Abraham.
- The ceremony served to renew the covenant, reminding the nation of the blessings of obedience and the curses of rebellion.
- Christian corporate worship continues to function as a weekly covenant renewal where believers recommit to Christ as Lord.
- The entire community, including children and foreigners, was present to learn and participate in hearing God's Word.
